jobs.title: Medical Field Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, work\-from\-home position. The candidate must be located in the** **Denver, Colorado** **area due to regular local travel for in\-person patient appointments.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management preferred (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Travel:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.
* **Transportation:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.


Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $71,000 \- $85,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in our productivity\-based bonus program. Your total compensation, including base pay and potential bonus, will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, education, and performance metrics.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*


\#LI\-CF1


\#FCM

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Specialist (Social Work/Counselor IV) - Division of Youth Services, Denver
jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

**This position will be accepting applications from residents and non\-residents of Colorado.**  

  

**This announcement is open to potential candidates who are legal residents of the United States. All legal residents of the United States are eligible to apply and compete. If appointed to a position, applicants from outside of Colorado will be required to relocate to Colorado prior to their start date, at their own expense.**  

  

  

Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.

  

  

  

**Division of Youth Services \- Youth Services Central Administration Office**  

**About the Division of Youth Services:**
  

The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides a continuum of residential and non\-residential services that encompass juvenile detention, commitment, and parole. DYS is the agency statutorily mandated to provide for the care and supervision of youth committed by the District Court to the custody of the Colorado Department of Human Services. The Division operates fifteen secure facilities that serve youth between the ages of 10 and 21 who are pre\-adjudicated, sentenced, or committed. The Division also contracts with numerous private residential and non\-residential service providers throughout the State. For pre\-adjudicated youth, the Division is also responsible for the management and oversight of Colorado Youth Detention Continuum, a State\-funded, locally administered program that provides services to youth at risk of further progressing into the juvenile justice system. In addition to residential programming, the Division administers juvenile parole services throughout the State.
  

  

We invite you to explore the DYS website and learn about the services provided to youth, families, and local communities in the State of Colorado at: https://www.colorado.gov/cdhs/dys
**Description of Job**
----------------------

  

  

You are required to work at your assigned work location during your scheduled work times.  

  

*Please note: Work arrangements are subject to change at any time*  

  

  

  

**Summary of Work Unit:**
The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides care and supervision of youth committed and detained by the courts, with a mission to build skills and competencies that support healthy development, accountability, and successful reintegration into the community. The Behavioral Health and Medical Services (BHMS) Unit provides statewide leadership, guidance, and oversight for behavioral health, medical, dental, psychological, neuropsychological, substance use, and sex\-offense\-specific services. The unit ensures that all services align with DYS policy, Colorado law, NCCHC standards, and evidence\-based practice expectations.
  

  

**About the Position:**  

  

The Behavioral Health Specialist (Social Worker/Counselor IV) ensures consistent delivery of high\-quality, evidence\-based behavioral health services and strengthens overall client care. This role directly supports client care by ensuring staff are equipped with the skills and knowledge necessary to provide effective, trauma\-informed, and individualized services.


In addition to training and oversight responsibilities, this position will provide direct youth/client care for critical cases needed to support service continuity, model best practices, and respond to emerging or high\-acuity situations. Through ongoing coaching, monitoring, and quality improvement efforts, this position promotes positive client outcomes, reduces risk, and ensures services are delivered safely, consistently, and in alignment with best practices.  

  

  



**Summary of Duties:**


**Clinical Assessment, Treatment, and Documentation**


* Provide advanced, licensed clinical services to youth with complex mental health, substance use, trauma\-related, and criminogenic needs within the Division of Youth Services.
* Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments; synthesizes collateral information from medical, educational, legal, and family systems; and formulates clinical impressions that inform individualized treatment planning.
* Deliver individual, group, and family therapy using evidence\-based modalities (e.g., CBT, DBT, Motivational Interviewing) and apply trauma\-informed and Sanctuary\-aligned practices.
* Develop, implement, and continuously update treatment plans aligned with risk, needs, and protective factors, and coordinate care with multidisciplinary partners.
* Evaluates treatment effectiveness, modifies interventions, and ensures continuity of care through transition and discharge planning.
* Provide precise, timely, and compliant documentation of all services, assessments, and clinical decisions in accordance with DORA, HIPAA, OCFMH, and DYS standards.

  

**Clinical and Programmatic Consultation, and Leadership**


* Provide advanced clinical consultation, leadership, and oversight to Behavioral Health Specialists, and interdisciplinary staff.
* Review complex cases, provide guidance on treatment approaches, and support staff in implementing effective behavioral interventions and crisis response strategies.
* Mentor and coach staff to improve clinical competency, reinforce fidelity to the DYS Treatment Model, and promote consistent application of trauma\-informed and evidence\-based practices.
* Provide indirect supervision, participate in hiring processes, and contribute to performance feedback and staff development.

**Training and Workforce Development**


* Develop, coordinate, and deliver behavioral health training and workforce development initiatives.
* Design curricula, facilitate training, and providing ongoing coaching and supervision to Behavioral Health Specialists, interns, and other staff.
* Ensures staff competency in clinical practices, documentation standards, and program expectations.
* Support internship and practicum programs, including recruitment, training, and supervision, and pr

jobs.description:
**Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Provides social work services to patients, their families and/or significant others through counseling, emotional support, assisting with environmental needs, crisis intervention, and group leadership.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Master's degree in social work or related field


2\. Current social worker licensure as required by the state where services are being performed:


**WV** : Licensed Graduate Social Worker (LGSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW ) **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker (LICSW) through the West Virginia Board of Social Work


**PA:** No state licensure required


**OH:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW), Licensed Independent Social Worker (LISW), **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker\-Supervision (LISW\-S) through the Ohio Board of Social Work


**MD:** Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW), **OR** Licensed Certified Social Worker\-Clinical (LISW\-C) through the Maryland Board of Social Work


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Certification in Case Management


2\. **PA:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW) **OR** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) through the Pennsylvania Board of Social Workers, Marriage and Family Therapists and Professional Counselors
  

**EXPERIENCE:**  

1\. Two (2\) years' social work experience.


**CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all\-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.


1\. Provide psychosocial assessments of patients and families to identify emotional, social, and community strengths and problems related to their diagnosis, illness, treatment, and/or life situation.
  

2\. Participates as an integral professional in a member of an interdisciplinary treatment team led by physician.
  

3\. Formulate, develop, and implement comprehensive treatment plans utilizing appropriate and evidence based treatments and interventions. Interventions may include crisis intervention, solution focused brief intervention, and any other.
  

4\. Screens, educate on diagnosis, and provide therapy and interventions to individuals with a variety of presenting problems including substance abuse, depression, and anxiety, thought disorders, trauma, and autism spectrum. May perform these functions independently or as part of a team. (if under the supervision of LICSW)
  

5\. Provide consultative services to health care team members within scope of care definitions as needed. Maintain a working knowledge of relevant medical/legal issues that impact on patient care, e.g., advance directives, child and elder abuse.
  

6\. Provide education to patients and families around issues related to adaptation to the patient's diagnosis, illness, treatment and/or life situation.
  

7\. Participate in multi\-disciplinary health care teams and represent clinical social work perspective/liaison with patient and family.
  

8\. May formulate, develop, and implement discharge plan beginning on the day of admission through length of stay.
  

9\. Acts as a liaison with community agencies and resources to assist patients and families as needed.
  

10\. May facilitate cognitive/psychoeducational group therapy at a minimum of once per day and provide individual Solution Focused Brief therapy and crisis intervention as ordered by doctor and/or as needed.
  

11\. Provide updates and information to families / support persons and care providers through length of patient stay and facilitate family meetings to provide discharge planning and education to family, as applicable.
  

12\. Facilitate referrals to placement options including but not limited to; personal care home, nursing home, skilled rehab, assisted living, group homes.
  

13\. Document assessment, plan, interactions, and interventions according to departmental, hospital and/or health system guidelines and standards.
  

14\. Maintain electronic medical records and documentation in accordance with department, hospital, medical center and/or health system policies. Attend and participate in staff, committee, department, and other administrative meetings.


**For facilities with specialty accreditation requirements:**1\. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In\-services, and competency validation.

1\. Flexible hours to include weekends and holidays for inpatient setting.

Maximus is seeking an experienced Licensed Clinical Supervisor to support the New Hampshire Comprehensive Assessment for Treatment (NH CAT) program. This role is responsible for supervising a team of clinical assessors and supporting the delivery of high\-quality behavioral health assessments for children, adolescents, and families.
  
  

The Clinical Supervisor will provide clinical leadership, coaching, quality oversight, case consultation, and operational guidance to ensure compliance with contract requirements, clinical standards, and program expectations. This position plays a key role in supporting assessment quality, staff development, and successful outcomes for youth and families served through the NH CAT program.
  
  

This is a fully remote position. Candidates do not need to reside in New Hampshire; however, occasional travel of up to 10% may be required for meetings, training, or program\-related activities if needed.
  
  

Why Maximus?
  
  

* Work/Life Balance Support \- Flexibility tailored to your needs!
* Competitive Compensation \-Bonuses based on performance included!
* ️ Comprehensive Insurance Coverage \- Choose from various plans, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, and partially funded HSA. Additionally, enjoy Life insurance benefits and discounts on Auto, Home, Renter's, and Pet insurance.
* Future Planning \- Prepare for retirement with our 401K Retirement Savings plan and Company Matching.
* ️ Unlimited Time Off Package \- Enjoy UTO, Holidays, and


extended sick leave, along with Short and Long Term Disability coverage.
  
  

* Holistic Wellness Support \- Access resources for physical, emotional, and financial wellness through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Recognition Platform \- Acknowledge and appreciate outstanding employee contributions.
* Tuition Reimbursement \- Invest in your ongoing education and development.
* Employee Perks and Discounts \- Additional benefits and discounts exclusively for employees.
* Maximus Wellness Program and Resources \- Access a range of wellness programs and resources tailored to your needs.
* Professional Development Opportunities\-Participate in training programs, workshops, and conferences.
* Licensures and Certifications\-Maximus assumes the expenses associated with renewing licenses and certifications for its employees.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Supervise support (hourly) level clinical staff. Lead, direct and review the work of team members in order to accomplish operational plans and results.
* Ensure adequate staff coverage for assigned program area.
* Serve as subject matter expert for identified area of program knowledge.
* Ensure assigned team is meeting contract and individual SLA's and related requirements.
* Work with contract management and shared services to identify opportunities for improvement and efficiencies.
* Monitor team activities and ensure adherence to established policies, procedures, and workflows.
* Communicate policies, practices, and procedures to team members and support implementation.
* Provide guidance, direction, and performance feedback to team members.
* May attend client and stakeholder meetings.
* Provide clinical guidance, coaching, and consultation to staff.
* Monitor quality, productivity, timeliness, and compliance with contract requirements.
* Conduct clinical review and provide feedback to ensure assessment quality and consistency.
* Support operational improvement initiatives and process standardization.
* Collaborate with state partners, internal leadership, quality, training, and operational teams.
* Support corrective action planning, quality initiatives, and staff development activities.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for child and adolescent behavioral health assessment practices.
* Specific clinical license and experience requirements based on contract requirements.
* Master's degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or another behavioral health\-related discipline
* Active independent clinical licensure as a Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW), Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor (LCMHC), or Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) or comparable independently practicing behavioral health clinician
* Employment is contingent upon successfully obtaining and maintaining all required New Hampshire licensure, credentialing, and program approvals necessary to perform the duties of the position.
* Minimum two (2\) years of supervisory, leadership, clinical, behavioral health, or related experience
* Minimum two (2\) years of experience working directly with children, adolescents, youth, and/or families
* Experience utilizing, reviewing, or supervising the completion of Child and Adolescent Needs and Strengths (CANS) assessments or comparable behavioral health assessment tools
* Experience coaching staff and managing performance
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

jobs.title: Continuing Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Continuing Education Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the administration, development, growth, and promotion of the organization’s continuing education programs. This position combines program coordination with business development, instructor recruitment, course development support, customer service, and marketing.

A significant focus of this position will be helping grow the continuing education program by identifying and recruiting qualified physicians, psychologists, and other professionals to develop and present courses, assisting with the development and launch of new educational offerings, and increasing awareness and enrollment through social media and other promotional channels.

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the supervisor to ensure courses and programs are well organized, professionally presented, and administered in accordance with applicable continuing education requirements.

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesContinuing Education Program Administration

* Assist with the day\-to\-day administration of the continuing education website and programs.
* Respond to participant questions regarding courses, registration, certificates, course access, and other administrative matters.
* Follow up with participants, instructors, and prospective instructors as needed.
* Monitor course registrations, completion requirements, evaluations, and other administrative components of continuing education programs.
* Assist with maintaining accurate course information, instructor information, schedules, and educational materials on the website.
* Identify administrative or participant issues and coordinate appropriate follow\-up and resolution.
* Help ensure continuing education documentation and records are maintained according to organizational and applicable regulatory requirements.

Program Growth \& Instructor Recruitment

A major responsibility of this position is assisting with the continued growth of the continuing education program.

* Identify and recruit physicians, psychologists, and other qualified professionals who may be interested in developing or presenting continuing education courses.
* Conduct outreach to prospective instructors and presenters through email, professional networks, associations, social media, and other appropriate sources.
* Follow up with prospective instructors and help guide them through the course development and onboarding process.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing instructors to encourage additional course development.
* Research potential course topics, presenters, professional trends, and areas of educational demand.
* Identify opportunities to expand the organization's course offerings and audience.
* Track recruitment and course\-development efforts and provide regular updates to the supervisor.

Course Development

* Assist with the development of new continuing education courses under the direction and guidance of the supervisor.
* Coordinate with instructors to obtain course materials, biographies, disclosures, learning objectives, examinations or assessments, references, and other required information.
* Assist instructors with understanding course\-development requirements and timelines.
* Review submitted materials for completeness and coordinate revisions or additional information as directed by the supervisor.
* Assist with organizing and preparing course content for publication on the continuing education platform.
* Help coordinate the process from initial course concept through final publication and promotion.

Tele\-Course \& Live Program Coordination

* Assist with the planning and administration of live and teleconference continuing education programs.
* Coordinate schedules with instructors and presenters.
* Communicate program instructions and requirements to presenters and participants.
* Assist with registration, attendance tracking, participant communications, evaluations, and certificates.
* Help manage the online or teleconference platform before and during scheduled programs.
* Conduct follow\-up after programs to address participant questions and complete required administrative documentation.

Marketing \& Social Media

* Assist with promoting continuing education programs through Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, email, professional organizations, and other appropriate channels.
* Create or coordinate promotional posts for new courses, upcoming tele\-courses, instructors, and other educational offerings.
* Help maintain a consistent schedule of social media and promotional activity.
* Identify additional opportunities to reach physicians, psychologists, mental health professionals, and other target audiences.
* Assist with email campaigns and other outreach efforts designed to increase course enrollment.
* Monitor the effectiveness of promotional efforts and help identify strategies for increasing engagement and enrollment.

General Responsibilities

* Maintain professional communication with participants, instructors, prospective instructors, and outside organizations.
* Maintain organized records of instructor contacts, prospective courses, course\-development status, and follow\-up activities.
* Meet established deadlines and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
* Participate in meetings regarding program development, marketing, and growth.
* Provide regular updates regarding instructor recruitment, courses in development, upcoming programs, and promotional activities.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with physicians, psychologists, and other healthcare professionals.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable learning and managing website\-based administrative systems.
* Familiarity with social media pla

jobs.title: Customer Service Supervisor – Enrollment & Customer Experience Leadership
jobs.description:
British Swim School is looking for a Customer Service Supervisor to lead our front\-end customer experience and enrollment operations.

This is not just a customer service role. This is a leadership position responsible for managing and developing a team of Customer Service Representatives while driving enrollment, retention, and overall customer satisfaction.

You will oversee daily communication with families, ensure operational excellence in scheduling and service, and build a team that delivers fast, accurate, and solution\-oriented support.

If you enjoy leading people, improving systems, and directly impacting growth through customer experience, this role offers the opportunity to grow within a mission\-driven organization focused on saving lives through water safety.

**Availability during evenings and weekends is required.**

***What You’ll Do***

Lead and manage customer service staff across all locations including:

● Customer Service Representatives (CSR)

● Sales Representatives

Your responsibilities will include:

**Team Leadership**

● Recruit, hire, and train customer service staff

● Coach CSRs to deliver high\-quality, solution\-oriented customer interactions

● Lead team trainings, role\-playing sessions, and ongoing staff development

● Build a positive, accountable, and performance\-driven team culture

**Customer Service Operations**

● Manage daily communication across phone, email, and chat channels

● Coordinate team schedules and coverage to ensure consistent response times

● Oversee customer account management including enrollments, makeups, holds, and changes

● Ensure smooth day\-to\-day execution of all customer service operations

**Enrollment \& Customer Experience**

● Drive enrollment growth through strong sales conversations and follow\-up

● Manage waitlists and proactively convert leads into active students

● Ensure all customer interactions align with company standards and expectations

● Resolve customer concerns and escalations with professionalism and urgency

**Systems \& Process Execution**

● Ensure accurate use of scheduling and CRM systems (Jackrabbit)

● Maintain consistency in policies, procedures, and communication standards

● Identify inefficiencies and improve workflows and team execution

● Ensure clean documentation and handoff between team members

**Why Join Our Team?**

● Make a Real Impact – Our mission is to prevent drownings by teaching life\-saving water safety skills. Every lesson matters.

● Growth \& Advancement – We invest in developing our team. Opportunities to grow into

higher\-level roles as we expand..

● Positive Team Culture – Supportive, energetic environment where teammates help each other succeed and celebrate wins together.

● Training \& Development – Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to build confidence in leadership, communication, and performance management.

● Fun \& Meaningful Work – Help families get started, stay enrolled, and progress in a program that truly changes lives.

Join a team where your work is fun, impactful, and truly makes a difference in your community.

**Qualifications**

● Proven leadership and staff management experience

● Background in customer service, call center, or sales environments

● Strong organizational and communication skills

● Ability to manage multiple priorities and a high\-volume workflow

● Experience with CRM/scheduling systems (Jackrabbit preferred)

● Passion for building a strong team culture and delivering excellent customer experience

**Common Prior Job Roles:**

Candidates from various customer service, sales, and administrative backgrounds excel in this role, including:

* Retail Sales Associate
* Administrative Assistant
* Hospitality or Front Desk Associate

**Pay Plan Title:** Peer Support Specialist**Working Title:** PeerSupport Specialist **\-** In Reach**Cost Center:** 9200/Community Transition**Position Number:** 17011**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt**Posting Salary Range:** $42,682 \- $54,205**Office Location:** Remote within Trillium’s Southern Region (See requirements section for included counties) **POSTING DETAILS:** **Make an Impact**  

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives. **Why Work for Us**?  

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:  

* A collaborative, mission\-driven work environment
* Competitive benefits and work\-from\-home options for most positions
* Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture
  

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school\-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.  

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today! **What We’re Looking For**  

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Peer Support Specialist to join our team! The Peer Support Specialist provides peer\-based support to individuals navigating care transitions, using lived experience to build trust and promote engagement in services. The role connects individuals to resources, supports participation in care, and promotes recovery, independence, and successful community integration. **On a typical day, you might:**  

* Provide peer\-based support using lived experience to build trust and support engagement in services.
* Support outreach and engagement efforts to connect individuals to services and community resources.
* Assist individuals in navigating services and accessing available supports.
* Facilitate group activities, educational sessions, and community engagement opportunities.
* Promote self\-advocacy, independence, and active participation in services.
 **Employee Benefits:**  

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:  

* Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
* Work\-from\-home options available for most positions
* Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
* NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined\-benefit plan) https://www.myncretirement.gov/systems\-funds/local\-governmental\-employees\-retirement\-system\-lgers/lgers\-handbook
* 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
* Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies
 **Qualifications**  

Required:* High School Diploma or GED.
* Be a person with (1\) year lived experience with a behavioral health condition and/or substance use.

* Must reside within Trillium’s Southern Region, which includes the following counties: Bladen, Brunswick, Columbus, Hoke, Lee, Moore, New Hanover, Robeson, and Scotland.
* Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:  

* Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties

Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, work\-from\-home position. The candidate must be located in the** **Denver, Colorado** **area due to regular local travel for in\-person patient appointments.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management preferred (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Travel:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.
* **Transportation:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.


Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $71,000 \- $85,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in our productivity\-based bonus program. Your total compensation, including base pay and potential bonus, will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, education, and performance metrics.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

new_jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

**This position will be accepting applications from residents and non\-residents of Colorado.**  

  

**This announcement is open to potential candidates who are legal residents of the United States. All legal residents of the United States are eligible to apply and compete. If appointed to a position, applicants from outside of Colorado will be required to relocate to Colorado prior to their start date, at their own expense.**  

  

  

Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.

  

  

  

**Division of Youth Services \- Youth Services Central Administration Office**  

**About the Division of Youth Services:**
  

The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides a continuum of residential and non\-residential services that encompass juvenile detention, commitment, and parole. DYS is the agency statutorily mandated to provide for the care and supervision of youth committed by the District Court to the custody of the Colorado Department of Human Services. The Division operates fifteen secure facilities that serve youth between the ages of 10 and 21 who are pre\-adjudicated, sentenced, or committed. The Division also contracts with numerous private residential and non\-residential service providers throughout the State. For pre\-adjudicated youth, the Division is also responsible for the management and oversight of Colorado Youth Detention Continuum, a State\-funded, locally administered program that provides services to youth at risk of further progressing into the juvenile justice system. In addition to residential programming, the Division administers juvenile parole services throughout the State.
  

  

We invite you to explore the DYS website and learn about the services provided to youth, families, and local communities in the State of Colorado at: https://www.colorado.gov/cdhs/dys
**Description of Job**
----------------------

  

  

You are required to work at your assigned work location during your scheduled work times.  

  

*Please note: Work arrangements are subject to change at any time*  

  

  

  

**Summary of Work Unit:**
The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides care and supervision of youth committed and detained by the courts, with a mission to build skills and competencies that support healthy development, accountability, and successful reintegration into the community. The Behavioral Health and Medical Services (BHMS) Unit provides statewide leadership, guidance, and oversight for behavioral health, medical, dental, psychological, neuropsychological, substance use, and sex\-offense\-specific services. The unit ensures that all services align with DYS policy, Colorado law, NCCHC standards, and evidence\-based practice expectations.
  

  

**About the Position:**  

  

The Behavioral Health Specialist (Social Worker/Counselor IV) ensures consistent delivery of high\-quality, evidence\-based behavioral health services and strengthens overall client care. This role directly supports client care by ensuring staff are equipped with the skills and knowledge necessary to provide effective, trauma\-informed, and individualized services.


In addition to training and oversight responsibilities, this position will provide direct youth/client care for critical cases needed to support service continuity, model best practices, and respond to emerging or high\-acuity situations. Through ongoing coaching, monitoring, and quality improvement efforts, this position promotes positive client outcomes, reduces risk, and ensures services are delivered safely, consistently, and in alignment with best practices.  

  

  



**Summary of Duties:**


**Clinical Assessment, Treatment, and Documentation**


* Provide advanced, licensed clinical services to youth with complex mental health, substance use, trauma\-related, and criminogenic needs within the Division of Youth Services.
* Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments; synthesizes collateral information from medical, educational, legal, and family systems; and formulates clinical impressions that inform individualized treatment planning.
* Deliver individual, group, and family therapy using evidence\-based modalities (e.g., CBT, DBT, Motivational Interviewing) and apply trauma\-informed and Sanctuary\-aligned practices.
* Develop, implement, and continuously update treatment plans aligned with risk, needs, and protective factors, and coordinate care with multidisciplinary partners.
* Evaluates treatment effectiveness, modifies interventions, and ensures continuity of care through transition and discharge planning.
* Provide precise, timely, and compliant documentation of all services, assessments, and clinical decisions in accordance with DORA, HIPAA, OCFMH, and DYS standards.

  

**Clinical and Programmatic Consultation, and Leadership**


* Provide advanced clinical consultation, leadership, and oversight to Behavioral Health Specialists, and interdisciplinary staff.
* Review complex cases, provide guidance on treatment approaches, and support staff in implementing effective behavioral interventions and crisis response strategies.
* Mentor and coach staff to improve clinical competency, reinforce fidelity to the DYS Treatment Model, and promote consistent application of trauma\-informed and evidence\-based practices.
* Provide indirect supervision, participate in hiring processes, and contribute to performance feedback and staff development.

**Training and Workforce Development**


* Develop, coordinate, and deliver behavioral health training and workforce development initiatives.
* Design curricula, facilitate training, and providing ongoing coaching and supervision to Behavioral Health Specialists, interns, and other staff.
* Ensures staff competency in clinical practices, documentation standards, and program expectations.
* Support internship and practicum programs, including recruitment, training, and supervision, and pr

**Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Provides social work services to patients, their families and/or significant others through counseling, emotional support, assisting with environmental needs, crisis intervention, and group leadership.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Master's degree in social work or related field


2\. Current social worker licensure as required by the state where services are being performed:


**WV** : Licensed Graduate Social Worker (LGSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW ) **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker (LICSW) through the West Virginia Board of Social Work


**PA:** No state licensure required


**OH:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW), Licensed Independent Social Worker (LISW), **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker\-Supervision (LISW\-S) through the Ohio Board of Social Work


**MD:** Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW), **OR** Licensed Certified Social Worker\-Clinical (LISW\-C) through the Maryland Board of Social Work


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Certification in Case Management


2\. **PA:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW) **OR** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) through the Pennsylvania Board of Social Workers, Marriage and Family Therapists and Professional Counselors
  

**EXPERIENCE:**  

1\. Two (2\) years' social work experience.


**CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all\-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.


1\. Provide psychosocial assessments of patients and families to identify emotional, social, and community strengths and problems related to their diagnosis, illness, treatment, and/or life situation.
  

2\. Participates as an integral professional in a member of an interdisciplinary treatment team led by physician.
  

3\. Formulate, develop, and implement comprehensive treatment plans utilizing appropriate and evidence based treatments and interventions. Interventions may include crisis intervention, solution focused brief intervention, and any other.
  

4\. Screens, educate on diagnosis, and provide therapy and interventions to individuals with a variety of presenting problems including substance abuse, depression, and anxiety, thought disorders, trauma, and autism spectrum. May perform these functions independently or as part of a team. (if under the supervision of LICSW)
  

5\. Provide consultative services to health care team members within scope of care definitions as needed. Maintain a working knowledge of relevant medical/legal issues that impact on patient care, e.g., advance directives, child and elder abuse.
  

6\. Provide education to patients and families around issues related to adaptation to the patient's diagnosis, illness, treatment and/or life situation.
  

7\. Participate in multi\-disciplinary health care teams and represent clinical social work perspective/liaison with patient and family.
  

8\. May formulate, develop, and implement discharge plan beginning on the day of admission through length of stay.
  

9\. Acts as a liaison with community agencies and resources to assist patients and families as needed.
  

10\. May facilitate cognitive/psychoeducational group therapy at a minimum of once per day and provide individual Solution Focused Brief therapy and crisis intervention as ordered by doctor and/or as needed.
  

11\. Provide updates and information to families / support persons and care providers through length of patient stay and facilitate family meetings to provide discharge planning and education to family, as applicable.
  

12\. Facilitate referrals to placement options including but not limited to; personal care home, nursing home, skilled rehab, assisted living, group homes.
  

13\. Document assessment, plan, interactions, and interventions according to departmental, hospital and/or health system guidelines and standards.
  

14\. Maintain electronic medical records and documentation in accordance with department, hospital, medical center and/or health system policies. Attend and participate in staff, committee, department, and other administrative meetings.

new_jobs.title: Continuing Education Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
The Continuing Education Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the administration, development, growth, and promotion of the organization’s continuing education programs. This position combines program coordination with business development, instructor recruitment, course development support, customer service, and marketing.

A significant focus of this position will be helping grow the continuing education program by identifying and recruiting qualified physicians, psychologists, and other professionals to develop and present courses, assisting with the development and launch of new educational offerings, and increasing awareness and enrollment through social media and other promotional channels.

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the supervisor to ensure courses and programs are well organized, professionally presented, and administered in accordance with applicable continuing education requirements.

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesContinuing Education Program Administration

* Assist with the day\-to\-day administration of the continuing education website and programs.
* Respond to participant questions regarding courses, registration, certificates, course access, and other administrative matters.
* Follow up with participants, instructors, and prospective instructors as needed.
* Monitor course registrations, completion requirements, evaluations, and other administrative components of continuing education programs.
* Assist with maintaining accurate course information, instructor information, schedules, and educational materials on the website.
* Identify administrative or participant issues and coordinate appropriate follow\-up and resolution.
* Help ensure continuing education documentation and records are maintained according to organizational and applicable regulatory requirements.

Program Growth \& Instructor Recruitment

A major responsibility of this position is assisting with the continued growth of the continuing education program.

* Identify and recruit physicians, psychologists, and other qualified professionals who may be interested in developing or presenting continuing education courses.
* Conduct outreach to prospective instructors and presenters through email, professional networks, associations, social media, and other appropriate sources.
* Follow up with prospective instructors and help guide them through the course development and onboarding process.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing instructors to encourage additional course development.
* Research potential course topics, presenters, professional trends, and areas of educational demand.
* Identify opportunities to expand the organization's course offerings and audience.
* Track recruitment and course\-development efforts and provide regular updates to the supervisor.

Course Development

* Assist with the development of new continuing education courses under the direction and guidance of the supervisor.
* Coordinate with instructors to obtain course materials, biographies, disclosures, learning objectives, examinations or assessments, references, and other required information.
* Assist instructors with understanding course\-development requirements and timelines.
* Review submitted materials for completeness and coordinate revisions or additional information as directed by the supervisor.
* Assist with organizing and preparing course content for publication on the continuing education platform.
* Help coordinate the process from initial course concept through final publication and promotion.

Tele\-Course \& Live Program Coordination

* Assist with the planning and administration of live and teleconference continuing education programs.
* Coordinate schedules with instructors and presenters.
* Communicate program instructions and requirements to presenters and participants.
* Assist with registration, attendance tracking, participant communications, evaluations, and certificates.
* Help manage the online or teleconference platform before and during scheduled programs.
* Conduct follow\-up after programs to address participant questions and complete required administrative documentation.

Marketing \& Social Media

* Assist with promoting continuing education programs through Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, email, professional organizations, and other appropriate channels.
* Create or coordinate promotional posts for new courses, upcoming tele\-courses, instructors, and other educational offerings.
* Help maintain a consistent schedule of social media and promotional activity.
* Identify additional opportunities to reach physicians, psychologists, mental health professionals, and other target audiences.
* Assist with email campaigns and other outreach efforts designed to increase course enrollment.
* Monitor the effectiveness of promotional efforts and help identify strategies for increasing engagement and enrollment.

General Responsibilities

* Maintain professional communication with participants, instructors, prospective instructors, and outside organizations.
* Maintain organized records of instructor contacts, prospective courses, course\-development status, and follow\-up activities.
* Meet established deadlines and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
* Participate in meetings regarding program development, marketing, and growth.
* Provide regular updates regarding instructor recruitment, courses in development, upcoming programs, and promotional activities.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with physicians, psychologists, and other healthcare professionals.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable learning and managing website\-based administrative systems.
* Familiarity with social media pla
